mainEntity.name: When should a remodeling company consider implementing an AEO strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: A remodeling company should consider implementing an AEO strategy as soon as they have an established online presence and are looking to increase their organic visibility and lead quality. It's particularly beneficial if your current SEO efforts aren't yielding the desired direct answers or featured snippets in search results. Proactive AEO helps position your business as an authority, capturing potential clients early in their research phase, especially when they are asking specific questions about their remodeling needs.
